description:
Optional Cortex AI function pack for Frostlake (SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX.COMPLETE, SENTIMENT,
        SUMMARIZE, TRANSLATE, EMBED_TEXT_*, the AI_ family), contributed to the engine via the
        FunctionProvider ServiceLoader SPI. The functions are answered by a locally-running Ollama server
        configured through frostlake.properties, so Cortex-shaped SQL runs against a model you host rather
        than a paid account. Add this module to the classpath to enable it. Dependency-free beyond the
        engine itself — the Ollama transport is java.net.http.
